title: 动手搭一个原电池
source_doc: course/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/11_Physically Constructing a Galvanic Cell (Electrochemistry).md
author_source: project/Fume Hood & Cabinet Protocols/11_Physically Constructing a Galvanic Cell (Electrochemistry)/src.py

points.K5: 两个半电池：阳极与阴极

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一节大电池模型，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a large cartoon battery model and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课我们动手搭一个原电池。

shots.scene: 两只烧杯、纸条盐桥和电压表组成的装置图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two beakers with metal strips, joined by a paper strip and wired to a small meter. No people.
shots.narration: 两只烧杯、两块金属，就能发电。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着手机，电量图标很低，一脸好奇
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks curiously at his phone showing a low battery icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰好奇：电池里的电从哪来？

shots.scene: 阿杰伸手去拿蓝色溶液瓶，没戴手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches bare-handed for a bottle of blue solution on the bench.
shots.narration: 他没戴手套，就要去拿硫酸铜。

shots.scene: 小研递给阿杰护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student safety goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 小研说：先看标签，戴好防护。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 先讲原理，再动手，最后说安全。

shots.scene: 一排圆柱形电池特写
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a row of generic cylindrical batteries with blank wrappers. No people.
shots.narration: 这一课不练常规操作，来看电池。

shots.scene: 化学能图标向下箭头指向闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: A flask icon with a down arrow pointing to a lightning bolt icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电池把化学能变成电能。

shots.scene: 电化学书本图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank book icon with a battery and a flask on its cover. No people.
shots.narration: 这属于化学的一个分支：电化学。

shots.scene: 两个原子之间有电子小球跳过去
shots.prompt_en: Two atom icons; a small electron ball jumps from the left atom to the right atom. No people.
shots.narration: 原电池靠自发的氧化还原反应发电。

shots.scene: 左边原子少一个电子标减号，右边多一个标加号
shots.prompt_en: The left atom loses an electron with a minus marker, the right atom gains one with a plus marker. No people.
shots.narration: 失去电子是氧化，得到电子是还原。

shots.scene: 河水推动水车转动
shots.prompt_en: A small river turning a wooden water wheel. No people.
shots.narration: 就像流水能推动水车。

shots.scene: 电子小球沿导线流动，点亮灯泡
shots.prompt_en: Small electron balls flow along a wire loop and light up a bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 电子的流动就是电流，也能做功。

shots.section_title: 两个半电池：阳极与阴极
shots.scene: 两只烧杯分开放，一个标氧化一个标还原
shots.prompt_en: Two separate beakers side by side, each with a metal strip, one marked with a minus sign, one with a plus sign. No people.
shots.narration: 把氧化和还原分开，放在两个半电池里。
overlay: 两个半电池：阳极与阴极

shots.section_title: 两个半电池：阳极与阴极
shots.scene: 左侧金属原子变成离子进入溶液，放出电子
shots.prompt_en: On the left electrode, metal atoms turn into ions that drift into the solution, releasing electrons into the wire. No people.
shots.narration: 阳极发生氧化：金属失电子成离子。

shots.section_title: 两个半电池：阳极与阴极
shots.scene: 右侧溶液中离子得电子沉积到电极上
shots.prompt_en: On the right electrode, ions from the solution gain electrons and deposit as metal on the strip. No people.
shots.narration: 阴极发生还原：离子得电子沉积。

shots.scene: 左烧杯灰色锌片在无色溶液中，右烧杯铜片在蓝色溶液中
shots.prompt_en: Left beaker: a gray metal strip in clear solution; right beaker: a copper-colored strip in blue solution. No people.
shots.narration: 最常见的例子是锌铜电池。

shots.scene: 锌原子放出两个电子变成离子
shots.prompt_en: A gray atom releases two electron balls and becomes an ion floating into the solution. No people.
shots.narration: 锌失去两个电子，变成锌离子。

shots.scene: 铜离子得到两个电子变成铜沉积
shots.prompt_en: A blue ion catches two electron balls and settles onto the copper strip as metal. No people.
shots.narration: 铜离子得到两个电子，析出铜。

shots.scene: 两烧杯之间搭着一条盐桥
shots.prompt_en: A bridge filled with salt solution connects the two beakers. No people.
shots.narration: 两个半电池要用盐桥连起来。

shots.scene: 离子在盐桥中两头移动，正负电荷平衡
shots.prompt_en: Small plus and minus ion icons move through the bridge in both directions, keeping both sides balanced. No people.
shots.narration: 盐桥传递离子，防止两边电荷堆积。

shots.scene: 两个电极接上灯泡，灯亮
shots.prompt_en: The two electrodes are wired to a small bulb that lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 接上灯泡，就能用上这股电。

shots.scene: 两个电极接上电压表，指针偏转
shots.prompt_en: The two electrodes are wired to a voltmeter whose needle swings. No people.
shots.narration: 接上电压表，就能测出电压。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜手套，向两只烧杯分别倒入无色和蓝色溶液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles, lab coat and gloves pours clear solution into one beaker and blue solution into another.
shots.narration: 两只烧杯，分别装硫酸锌和硫酸铜。

shots.scene: 锌片放入无色溶液，铜片放入蓝色溶液
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand places a gray strip into the clear solution and a copper strip into the blue solution.
shots.narration: 锌片配硫酸锌，铜片配硫酸铜。

shots.scene: 电极配错溶液的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gray strip placed in the blue beaker, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电极和溶液要一一对应，不能放错。

shots.scene: U形玻璃管装满盐溶液
shots.prompt_en: A U-shaped glass tube filled with clear salt solution, ends plugged with cotton. No people.
shots.narration: 盐桥可以用装满盐溶液的U形管。

shots.scene: 小研剪滤纸条，浸进盐溶液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student cuts a strip of filter paper and dips it into a small dish of salt solution.
shots.narration: 也可以把滤纸条浸透盐溶液。

shots.scene: 湿纸条两头分别搭进两个烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The wet paper strip is draped across both beakers with each end dipping into a solution. No people.
shots.narration: 两头分别浸入两个烧杯，连通起来。

shots.scene: 数字电表用鳄鱼夹连上两个电极
shots.prompt_en: A generic digital multimeter connected with alligator clips to the two metal strips. No people.
shots.narration: 夹上电表，马上就有读数。

shots.scene: 电表屏幕上一个闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: The multimeter display shows a lightning bolt icon and a needle-like bar rising. No people.
shots.narration: 读数约一伏，电已经产生了。

shots.scene: 一张空白的电位表和一个计算器图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank table of values and a calculator icon. No people.
shots.narration: 每个半反应的标准电位都能查表。

shots.scene: 阴极减阳极的公式卡
shots.prompt_en: A formula card with two boxes and a minus sign between them, an arrow to a result box. No people.
shots.narration: 电动势等于阴极电位减阳极电位。

shots.scene: 理论值与实验值两个柱子高度接近
shots.prompt_en: Two bars of similar height side by side, one solid and one striped. No people.
shots.narration: 算出理论值，和实测值比一比。

shots.scene: 三只烧杯，蓝色深浅不同
shots.prompt_en: Three beakers of blue solution in different shades from light to dark. No people.
shots.narration: 溶液浓度也会影响电压。

shots.scene: 天平图标：两边同时减半仍平衡
shots.prompt_en: A balance icon: both sides halved at the same time and still level, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 关键看两边浓度的比值。

shots.scene: 两侧同减半，电表读数不变
shots.prompt_en: Both beakers get lighter together and the meter bar stays the same height. No people.
shots.narration: 两边同时减半，电压不变。

shots.scene: 只改一侧，读数变化
shots.prompt_en: Only one beaker gets lighter and the meter bar changes height. No people.
shots.narration: 只改一边浓度，电压就会变。

shots.scene: 小研把一侧换成绿色溶液和新电极
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in goggles and gloves replaces one half-cell with a beaker of green solution and a new metal strip.
shots.narration: 测完可以换一侧，比如换成镍电极。

shots.scene: 三个半电池两两连线，出现三条线
shots.prompt_en: Three beaker icons connected pair by pair with three lines. No people.
shots.narration: 三个半电池，可以组成三种电池。

shots.scene: 四个半电池两两连线，出现六条线
shots.prompt_en: Four beaker icons connected pair by pair with six lines. No people.
shots.narration: 四个半电池，可以组成六种。

shots.scene: 电表图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A multimeter icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 测电压的方法都一样。

shots.scene: 手机和汽车图标，内部有电池
shots.prompt_en: A smartphone icon and a car icon, each with a glowing battery inside. No people.
shots.narration: 手机和汽车里的电池也是这个原理。

shots.scene: 电池剖面图：两极和中间隔层
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway of a battery cell showing two electrodes and a separator layer between them. No people.
shots.narration: 电极反应更复杂，但同样是两个半电池。

shots.scene: 离子通道与外电路的示意
shots.prompt_en: Ions move through the middle layer while electrons flow through an outer wire to a bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 内部走离子，外部走电流。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着试剂瓶上的危险象形图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at hazard pictograms on a reagent bottle with a blank label.
shots.narration: 硫酸铜、镍盐都是重金属盐。

shots.scene: 健康危害、刺激性、环境危害三个象形图
shots.prompt_en: Three hazard pictograms in a row: health hazard, exclamation mark, and environment. No people.
shots.narration: 有毒或有刺激性，镍盐还可能致敏。

shots.scene: 小研翻看一份空白的安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank safety data sheet next to the bottle.
shots.narration: 用前先看标签和安全技术说明书。

shots.scene: 小研展示护目镜、实验服、手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shows her safety goggles, buttoned lab coat and nitrile gloves.
shots.narration: 护目镜、实验服、手套都要戴好。

shots.scene: 实验台上的水杯和零食图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a drink cup and a snack on a lab bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不吃东西、不喝水。

shots.scene: 阿杰摘下手套后在水槽洗手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student removes his gloves and washes his hands with soap at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 做完实验，摘下手套认真洗手。

shots.scene: 砂纸打磨金属片，手戴手套
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand polishes a metal strip with sandpaper on a protective pad. No people.
shots.narration: 金属电极常要先用砂纸打磨干净。

shots.scene: 金属片锋利边缘的警示图标
shots.prompt_en: A metal strip with a sharp edge highlighted and a small yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 边缘很锋利，小心割手。

shots.scene: 打磨下的粉末收进废物纸
shots.prompt_en: Metal dust from sanding is folded into a paper and placed in a solid waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 打磨下的金属粉末不要随手乱扔。

shots.scene: 电表旋钮转到电压档
shots.prompt_en: A hand turns a generic multimeter dial to the voltage setting. No people.
shots.narration: 电表先选对档位再测量。

shots.scene: 鳄鱼夹浸在溶液里的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an alligator clip dipped into the solution, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 夹子夹在电极上端，别泡进溶液。

shots.scene: 湿手摸插座的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wet hand reaching for a power socket, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 电压虽低，也不湿手碰电器。

shots.scene: 滤纸条盐桥一端与蓝色溶液接触处出现棕色沉淀
shots.prompt_en: Where the paper strip touches the blue solution, a brown cloudy patch forms, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 原片的盐桥用了碘化钾。

shots.scene: 铜离子与碘离子反应的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a blue ion meeting a purple ion and forming a brown cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 它会和铜离子反应，出现副反应。

shots.scene: 两个白色试剂瓶打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two bottles of white salt with blank labels, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 常用硝酸钾或氯化钾，以讲义为准。

shots.scene: 蓝色和绿色溶液倒入重金属废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Blue and green solutions are poured through a funnel into a heavy metal waste container with a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 含铜、锌、镍的废液单独收集。

shots.scene: 水槽下水道图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of blue solution poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能倒进下水道。

shots.scene: 用过的金属片冲洗后放回回收盒
shots.prompt_en: Used metal strips are rinsed and placed in a labeled return tray. No people.
shots.narration: 电极冲洗擦干，交回或按规定处置。

shots.scene: 废旧电池投进专用回收箱
shots.prompt_en: Old batteries go into a dedicated battery recycling box. No people.
shots.narration: 废旧电池放进专用回收箱。

shots.scene: 鼓包电池的警示图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a swollen battery with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 鼓包、破损的电池可能起火，别乱丢。

shots.scene: 蓝色溶液洒在台面，小研用吸附垫擦拭
shots.prompt_en: Blue solution spilled on the bench; the female graduate student in gloves wipes it up with absorbent pads.
shots.narration: 溶液洒了，戴手套用吸附材料清理。

shots.scene: 阿杰在洗眼器前冲洗眼睛，小研扶着他
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his eyes at an eyewash station while the female graduate student supports him.
shots.narration: 溅进眼睛，立即用洗眼器冲洗。

shots.scene: 手臂在水龙头下冲洗
shots.prompt_en: A forearm is rinsed under running water at a lab sink. No people.
shots.narration: 沾到皮肤，用大量流水冲洗。

shots.scene: 电话图标和红十字，120
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 不适就医，紧急拨打120。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports to the older man at the lab doorway; he listens and nods.
shots.narration: 事后报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现两个半电池和盐桥图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of two half-cells linked by a salt bridge.
shots.narration: 阳极氧化，阴极还原，盐桥连通。

shots.scene: 电表、公式卡、浓度烧杯图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a multimeter, a formula card and beakers of different shades. No people.
shots.narration: 测电压，算理论值，看浓度比。

shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、重金属废液桶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of safety goggles, gloves and a heavy metal waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 看标签、戴防护、废液单独收集。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一节亮起的电池模型挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye while holding a glowing cartoon battery model.
shots.narration: 电从反应来，安全记心间，下次见！
